# `historical_veto_administrations`

**Historical presidential veto totals by administration**

Senate veto counts by publisher-stated administration span, with literal cells, footnotes and source coordinates.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Complete administration rows within one selected dated Senate summary capture, with all category sums reconciled to its footer. Administration spans may cover multiple terms. Nonconsecutive administrations stay separate. Current-administration counts reflect observation time; no individual veto-event or bill population is inferred. Snapshot and footnote evidence state scope and disputed exclusions. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `historical_veto_administrations.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the original HTML bytes; identical bytes share this identity across observations. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact Senate summary URL, not the linked per-president document. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Capture timestamp with timezone, separate from the administration's stated years. |
| `president` | `VARCHAR` | President label with the parenthesized years and footnote markers separated; no cross-span identity inference. |
| `administration_label_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal first-cell text including whitespace and footnote markers. |
| `years_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal parenthesized source year span, including abbreviated endings or a single year. |
| `coinciding_congresses_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Congress cell; order, punctuation and whitespace stay as published. |
| `regular_vetoes` | `BIGINT` | Explicit regular-veto count from this span's source cell. |
| `pocket_vetoes` | `BIGINT` | Explicit pocket-veto count under the retained publisher footnotes. |
| `total_vetoes` | `BIGINT` | Publisher total, checked equal to regular plus pocket; overridden vetoes are not added. |
| `overridden_vetoes` | `BIGINT` | Regular vetoes overridden by Congress, a subset of regular vetoes. |
| `footnotes_json` | `VARCHAR` | Referenced footnote definitions with literal text, HTML and original-byte coordinates. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Source row path rooted at the selected table and byte offsets in the full original. |
| `raw_row_json` | `VARCHAR` | Every source cell with literal text, HTML, attributes, coordinates and footnote references. |
